2.3 2K rendering and native material revision
2K photographic surfaces, plants and HDR sky: original Poly Haven CC0 sources. See hd2k/NATURE-SOURCES.md and hd2k/nature-manifest.json for original files, attribution and conversion details. Periodic 2048 water-wave normal is project-generated, not enlarged from the old source.
M700 and Rocketbox native 2K images restored from the original credited authors. AKM retains its credited original 2K delivery. Newly authored 2K tactical glove and GL-6 microfinish maps are project CC0 work. NPC holstered pistol source images remain original 1K. See hd2k/EQUIPMENT-SOURCES.md and equipment-manifest.json; Rocketbox MIT license remains in models/rocketbox-soldier/LICENSE.md.
Rendering, memory-budgeted streaming and glTF material-slot fallback are project code. Raster UI is not used to fake 2K game output.

2.2 character, AKM and sight-alignment revision
Active third weapon: Weathered AKM, LonesomeDucky, CC0-1.0.
https://opengameart.org/content/weathered-akm-rifle
Original authored mesh (5,322 triangles), UVs, PBR color/roughness/metal/AO/normal maps and custom split normals preserved; converted to metres. Source 4K maps reduced to 2K delivery; mobile pack 1K, desktop pack 2K. Full-chroma JPEG, color quality 94 and normal/ORM 95 before pack compression. Not a scan or manufacturer CAD. See models/akm/SOURCE.md and conversion.json. Replaces the retained legacy M4A1 below.
Active combatant: Microsoft Rocketbox Military_Male_03, Microsoft / Rocketbox, MIT.
https://github.com/microsoft/Microsoft-Rocketbox/tree/master/Assets/Avatars/Professions/Military_Male_03
Original same-skeleton Idle/Walk/Run animations from Assets/Animations. Original military avatar converted from FBX, normalized to metres, with original UVs, skeleton and color/normal maps. Full MIT text in models/rocketbox-soldier/LICENSE.md; conversion details in SOURCE.md and conversion.json. Replaces the retained Three.js Soldier below.
Added 7.62 x39 brass case and copper bullet: original metre-scale geometry, CC0-1.0, in ammunition.js. Sight-marker calibration, independent reticle canvas and runtime grip IK are project code.

2.1 weapon, ammunition and forest-floor revision
Active GL-6: original authored Wild Frontier model and microfinish maps, CC0-1.0. 0.838 m, open barrel and six drum chambers, 8,178 triangles. Not a scan, manufacturer CAD, or the retained legacy 3DAssets.dev launcher below. See models/gl6/SOURCE.md.
Cartridge cases and copper projectiles: original authored metre-scale geometry/materials, CC0-1.0. 5.56 x45, 7.62 x51 and 40 x46 case forms. See ammunition.js. Gameplay bullet behaviour is an approximation.
M4A1: original credited CC0 asset below; removed zero-area triangles and repaired invalid normals without replacing the original UVs or PBR finish maps. See source-assets/legacy/models/m4a1/SOURCE.md in the source repository.
Forest understorey and roadside stones reuse the credited fern_02 and rock_moss_set_01 photographic assets below. No additional external source assets.

2.0 full-leaf canopy, ground rendering and midday photographic lighting
Current woodland tree: nature/woodland_tree_03/ from tree_small_02, Rico Cilliers, Poly Haven CC0. Individual original leaf UV islands fitted to their own planes; 63,194/41,137triangles. Replaces the large crossed-cluster canopy at near/mid distance. Existing tree02 eight-angle far atlas reused.
Current HDR sky: Kloofendal48dPartlyCloudy(PureSky), original GregZaal, sky edits JarodGuest, PolyHavenCC0. https://polyhaven.com/a/kloofendal_48d_partly_cloudy_puresky
Optional high-quality 2K LeafyGrass and Rock01 photographic diffuse/normal textures. See textures/detail/SOURCE.md and environment/SOURCE.md. Grass/rock baseline maps are retained at1K on phones. Stochastic tile offsets, matched normal coordinates and thin-leaf light transmission are authored real-time effects, not additional scanned content.

1.9 island countryside and rural architecture revision
Rural buildings: original authored geometry (stucco openings, roof, window trim, doors, gutters, stairs and chimney), built for this game using the existing credited surface photography. Not a scan, official PUBG asset or copy of its map. Terrain combines credited elevations with authored island beaches, river, village site grading and paths.

1.8 hands and landscape integration revision

Hands-only tactical gloves: original anatomical hands and rig from
FPS Arms (rigged, only) by para / MakeHuman, CC0.
https://opengameart.org/content/fps-arms-rigged-only
New gloves remove arm surfaces and add capped cuffs, cloth, leather palm
reinforcement, rubber knuckle cushions, closures and stitch geometry.
New garment geometry and procedural tiled PBR maps are original CC0 work.
These are authored game models and maps, not photographs or new scans.
See models/gloved-hands/SOURCE.md and conversion.json.

Landscape retains the credited elevation and photographic assets below.
Shore/river grading, root blending and HDR-matched lighting are game adaptations.

1.7 field and woodland revision

Ground grass: Leafy Grass by Charlotte Baglioni, Poly Haven, CC0.
https://polyhaven.com/a/leafy_grass
Original 2K diffuse/normal/roughness photographs resized to 1K without recoloring.

Second tree: tree_small_02 by Rico Cilliers, Poly Haven, CC0.
https://polyhaven.com/a/tree_small_02
Derived Woodland Tree 02 uses the original reduced 3D bark/branches and
41 local photo leaf clusters baked from the original textured leaf surfaces.
Near/mid LOD 3,239/1,747 triangles; whole-tree impostors are distant only.
See nature/woodland_tree_02/SOURCE.md and conversion.json.

Wild Frontier FPS 1.6 — asset attribution

Three.js r164, GLTFLoader, RGBELoader, SkeletonUtils, BufferGeometryUtils
MIT. See vendor/LICENSE.
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r164
Soldier.glb and waternormals.jpg: bundled Three.js example resources.
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r164/examples/models/gltf/Soldier.glb

Nature models, photographic PBR surfaces and sky: Poly Haven, CC0.
https://polyhaven.com/license
Models: tree_small_02, grass_medium_01, rock_moss_set_01,
fern_02 and flower_heliophila.
1.6 active replacements: island_tree_02, grass_medium_02, rock_face_01.
https://polyhaven.com/a/island_tree_02
https://polyhaven.com/a/grass_medium_02
https://polyhaven.com/a/rock_face_01
Tree: Rob Tuytel, Rico Cilliers. Grass: Rico Cilliers. Rock: Dario Barresi.
New tree LODs preserve photographed leaf masks and UVs; distant tree
atlas is baked from the original 3D model, not a separately generated image.
New grass LODs retain individual blade islands and their original UVs.
See each active model's SOURCE.md and conversion.json.
https://polyhaven.com/a/tree_small_02
https://polyhaven.com/a/grass_medium_01
https://polyhaven.com/a/rock_moss_set_01
https://polyhaven.com/a/fern_02

Textures: rocky_trail, rock_01, aerial_grass_rock, brown_mud_leaves_01,
metal_plate, plaster_brick_01, grey_roof_tiles, wood_planks_dirt.
HDRI: kloppenheim_06_puresky.
Tree meshes have three LODs, simplified with meshoptimizer (MIT).
Foliage diffuse textures include the original alpha masks. Flower meshes
are simplified while retaining UVs; fern variants retain source geometry.

M4A1: nisu, CC0 1.0 Universal.
https://opengameart.org/content/m4a1-assault-rifle
Original FBX converted to glTF; original PBR maps reduced to 1024px;
mechanical parts and muzzle retained. See source-assets/legacy/models/m4a1/SOURCE.md in the source repository.

M700: Stein Games, CC0 1.0 Universal.
https://stein-indie.itch.io/m700
Original FBX converted to glTF with rigid mechanical parts, original PBR
maps and attachment markers. See models/m700/SOURCE.md.

GL-6 grenade launcher, optical scope and retained legacy gun models:
3DAssets.dev, CC0.
https://3dassets.dev/assets/mega-weapon-pack-revolving-grenade-launcher-40fccdbc
https://3dassets.dev/assets/mega-weapon-pack-bolt-sniper-chassis-scoped-891e227c
https://3dassets.dev/assets/mega-weapon-pack-standard-rifle-94762172
Scope extracted and simplified from the legacy sniper model.
All weapon assets are authored meshes, not firearm photogrammetry.

Dedicated first-person anatomical arms: para / MakeHuman team, CC0.
https://opengameart.org/content/fps-arms-rigged-only
Converted from the author's FBX; original skin UVs and finger rig preserved.
Units and inverse binds normalized; gameplay applies grip IK and finger poses.
See models/fps-arms/SOURCE.md.

Recorded sound effects: CC0. Per-file sources, authors, recorded weapons,
crop offsets and processing are in audio/SOURCES.json.
Winchester Magnum XTR shot, forest, leaf and water footsteps:
Joseph SARDIN / BigSoundBank.
https://bigsoundbank.com/shot-of-winchester-magnum-xtr-s0397.html
https://bigsoundbank.com/forest-s0100.html
https://bigsoundbank.com/feet-in-leaves-s0137.html
https://bigsoundbank.com/shoes-in-the-water-s0690.html
M16 shot, M32 launch and distant grenade explosion:
qubodup / public-domain US government training recordings.
https://freesound.org/people/qubodup/sounds/238916/
https://freesound.org/people/qubodup/sounds/162361/
https://freesound.org/people/qubodup/sounds/162363/
Recorded reload/bolt handling: qubodup, using serøtōnin's CC0 recordings.
https://freesound.org/people/qubodup/sounds/815879/
Recorded casing drop: BlondPanda.
https://freesound.org/people/BlondPanda/sounds/778026/
Audio is cropped, level adjusted and resampled; forest has a loop crossfade.
Recordings are sound-design substitutes, not exact recordings of every
displayed weapon. Game gunshots do not use oscillator/noise synthesis.

Mountain relief: Mapzen / Tilezen open elevation tile service.
https://s3.amazonaws.com/elevation-tiles-prod/terrarium/12/2194/1430.png
https://github.com/tilezen/joerd/blob/master/docs/formats.md
https://github.com/tilezen/joerd/blob/master/docs/attribution.md
European elevation attribution: Copernicus / European Union (EU-DEM);
Austria elevation: © offene Daten Österreichs, DGM Österreich.
Global elevation sources include SRTM and GMTED2010 supplied by USGS,
and ETOPO1 supplied by NOAA. Data-provider notices remain applicable;
the elevation compilation is not labeled as CC0.
For this game the tile is rotated 180 degrees, resampled to 129x129,
height scaled by 0.057 and placed on a 640m game area, with procedural
microrelief, lake/river flattening and road shaping. This is an adapted
game landscape, not a geographic reproduction or navigation dataset.

Barlow: SIL Open Font License. See fonts/OFL.txt.
Resource conversion helpers: Three.js / fflate (MIT), meshoptimizer (MIT).
See scripts/vendor/ licenses in the source repository.
Startup resource decompression: fflate, MIT; see vendor/fflate-LICENSE.
Startup bundles preserve geometry/animations and resize environmental photos
to 512px (mobile) or 1024px (desktop). Weapon/arm/character photos retain 1024px; desktop AKM maps retain 2048px and
distant tree atlas retains its 2048px width. Source attribution and alpha
masks remain applicable. Mobile close tree detail uses the medium mesh.
Game code, UI, surface blending, particles and remaining interface tones:
this project.

Enemy combat callouts (V2.26): synthetic recordings generated locally using
Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-CustomVoice, revision
0c0e3051f131929182e2c023b9537f8b1c68adfe, qwen-tts 0.1.1, CPU inference.
Model card: https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-CustomVoice
Model license declared by Qwen: Apache-2.0. Model weights are not distributed.
Preset voices: Dylan (scout), Uncle_Fu (veteran), Ryan (leader), speaking Chinese.
Original dialogue and per-line acting directions: this project; see
sources/combat-voice-direction.json in the source repository.
No remote inference API, voice cloning, pitch shift or speed change was used.

Human pain / terminal vocal reactions (V2.27): HaelDB,
"Male Grunt/Yelling sounds", OpenGameArt, 2012-04-12.
https://opengameart.org/content/male-gruntyelling-sounds
CC0 1.0 option selected: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
32 edited human recordings, four fixed performer groups. Excerpts trimmed,
rumble filtered, edges faded and levels balanced; no pitch/speed changes.
Original archive SHA256:
e9100a4e3b9dcd146993089970dc6097dcf9935fa4683b196040012bad65d67a
Source edit plan and reproduction helper are in sources/human-vocal-reactions.json
and scripts/prepare-human-reactions.py in the source repository.
Existing Chinese tactical dialogue remains synthetic; the new reflex vocals
are recordings of separate human performers, not cloned versions of those voices.
